name: poolday
description: Make and edit videos, images and other media with the Poolday AI agent from a chat: hand it a brief, follow the task in a live panel, answer its questions and get the finished outputs back.

interface.longDescription: Poolday is an AI video editing platform. With this plugin you brief the Poolday agent from the chat and it does the production work in your Poolday workspace: scripting, footage, voiceover, music, captions, brand kits and rendering. A task runs for minutes in the background. The plugin shows it in a live panel with its status, any question the agent needs answered, and the finished video or image outputs with links to open them in Poolday. You can follow up on a task with a change ("make it 15 seconds", "use the second voice"), answer the agent's questions from the chat, find earlier tasks, and drop files from your computer into the panel so a task can use them. Media already in your Poolday library can be referenced in a brief, and links to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or web pages are fetched by Poolday. Connecting asks you to sign in to Poolday and pick one workspace; everything the plugin does happens in that workspace, as you, within your workspace's permissions and credits.
capabilities: Start a video or media production task from a brief
Follow a running task in a live panel with its status and outputs
Answer the agent's questions without leaving the chat
Send follow-up changes to a finished task
Find earlier tasks in your workspace
Drop files from your computer into Poolday for a task to use
Reference media already in your Poolday library
defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second vertical product video for our new app, upbeat tone, with captions
How is my Poolday task going?
Turn this YouTube video into three short clips for TikTok

positive.description: Start a production task from a brief
positive.prompt: Use Poolday to make a 20-second vertical video announcing our summer sale, upbeat tone, with captions. Just start it, I'll check later.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls start_task once with the brief, tells the user the task has started and shows the Poolday task panel in the working state. It does not poll in a loop.

positive.description: Check on a task when asked
positive.prompt: How is my Poolday video task going?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant finds the most recent task with list_tasks when it has no task id, reads it with get_task, and reports its status in words: still working, waiting on a question, or done with the outputs listed. No panel is opened for a check.

positive.description: Answer a question the agent is waiting on
positive.prompt: Start a Poolday task in clarify mode: a 15-second video about our coffee brand.
positive.expected_behavior: The task is started with mode 'clarify' and the panel shows it working. About two minutes later ask "Does Poolday have a question for me?": the assistant reads the task with get_task, which reports needs_input, and relays Poolday's question. Reply with answers such as "Brand name: Morning Roast. Warm artisan look, 9:16. Young professionals, calm tone. Poolday can decide the rest.": the assistant sends them with answer_question and the task continues.

positive.description: Follow up on a finished task with a change
positive.prompt: Take my latest finished Poolday task and make the video 10 seconds shorter.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant locates the task, confirms it is not running, and sends the change with send_message. If the task is still working, it relays Poolday's refusal and offers to try again later instead of starting a twin task.

positive.description: Use a file from the user's computer
positive.prompt: I want Poolday to add captions to a clip that is on my laptop.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant opens the upload panel with add_files before starting the task. Once the user has dropped the file in, it starts the task referencing the uploaded asset.

negative.prompt: Write me a cover letter for a marketing job.

negative.description: Asks for Poolday pricing or billing changes, which the plugin cannot do
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Poolday plan and add 500 credits to my account.

negative.description: Nearby but out of scope: editing in another tool
negative.prompt: Open Premiere Pro and apply a warp stabilizer to my timeline.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Work runs against credits the user already has in their Poolday workspace.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: start, follow, answer and steer Poolday video and media production tasks from ChatGPT, with a live task panel.
